h:
Most believers today don’t reject the law because they’ve studied it. They reject it because they were taught lies by people who never submitted to it.

Let’s tear those lies down one by one.

1. “The Law Was Just for Israel”

This is the lie of selective covenant.
As if Yah’s standards are tribal. As if the King of the universe only governs one ethnicity.

Wrong.

“One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.” Exodus 12:49

Torah was given through Israel, but it was meant for anyone who joins the Kingdom. If you’re grafted in, you’re under the same standard.

Not Jewish laws. Kingdom laws.

2. “Jesus Fulfilled the Law So We Don’t Have To”

The ultimate misunderstanding of “fulfill.”

“Do not think that I came to destroy the Law or the Prophets. I did not come to destroy but to fulfill.” Matthew 5:17

The word “fulfill” here means to bring to fullness, completion, or full expression, not erase.

Yahusha fulfilled the law perfectly, so He could transfer it into you, by the Spirit.

He didn’t free you from obedience. He freed you from the condemnation of disobedience.

Now you obey from fire, not fear.

3. “We’re Under Grace, Not Law”

Romans 6:14 is their golden bullet. But they stop halfway through the war.

“You are not under law but under grace.”

They never read the next line:

“What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? God forbid.” Romans 6:15

Being under grace means you’re no longer condemned by the law when you fall. It does not mean the law is gone.

Grace doesn’t erase law. It empowers you to keep it from the inside out.

“I will put My law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts.” Jeremiah 31:33

If the law is written on your heart, it still exists.

4. “The Law Is Legalism”

Legalism is using law to justify yourself. Torah is the King’s protocol for righteous living.

People confuse obedience with legalism because they’ve been taught to fear structure.

Yahusha obeyed the law flawlessly, and called others to do the same.

“If you love Me, keep My commandments.” John 14:15

Obedience isn’t bondage. It’s alignment with divine government.

Satan fears obedience more than worship, because obedience brings dominion.

5. “We Just Follow the Spirit Now”

As if the Spirit contradicts the Word that birthed Him.

“The law is spiritual.” Romans 7:14

The Spirit of God will never lead you to violate Torah. Because Torah is a reflection of His very nature.

If you’re “led by the Spirit” but dismiss Yah’s law, you’re not Spirit-led.
You’re following a counterfeit that cosigns your rebellion.

Real Spirit walk leads you into holiness, not lawlessness.

Torah was never man’s system. It was Heaven’s. It doesn’t compete with grace. It completes it.

“Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid. Yea, we establish the law.” Romans 3:31

The war on Torah is a war on Kingdom order. And the sons are done being silent.

The law isn’t gone.
It’s rising.
